data.title: About Patricia
bio: With a real estate career spanning more than three decades, Trish Reagan has been helping buyers and sellers navigate the New Jersey market since earning her license in 1991.  She has successfully listed and sold homes throughout the state and brings a deep understanding of residential real estate, contracts, and property conditions to every transaction.  Trish is also a Commissioner on the South Amboy Housing Authority since 2022, giving her a unique insight and perspective on real estate current events.

In addition to her brokerage experience, Trish previously held a title license and is the founder of a company that partners with multiple Housing Authorities to perform HUD inspections, giving her unique insight into compliance standards, and the behind the scenes details that matter.  This well-rounded background allows her to guide clients with confidence, accuracy, and transparency.  Outside of real estate, she values time spent with family and friends and has life long love of live music.
Well known for her straightforward style, strong work ethic, and commitment to her clients, Trish approaches every deal with professionalism and care from start to finish.
